get.description:
Retrieve account information using the account KRN.
## Access Control
Any of the following allow access:
- requester has the `acct:account:r` permission for the client-realm
  that contains this account

- A relationship links the requester to this account (for example,
  consumer-to-account)

parameters.name: accountKrn
parameters.description: The KRN of the account to retrieve

parameters.name: excludeBalance
parameters.description: Set to true to exclude balance information from the response

put.description:
Update an existing account identified by its KRN.
## Access Control
Requester must have the `acct:account:u` permission for the space containing this account.

parameters.name: accountKrn
parameters.description: The KRN of the account to update

extensionFields.description: Client-defined extension field values for this account

patch.description:
Applies an [RFC 7396](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7396) JSON Merge Patch to the account identified by its KRN. Fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged; fields explicitly set to `null` are cleared, subject to validation of any fields that are required. Nested objects (for example `mailingAddress`, `lookupFields`, `extensionFields`) are merged recursively per RFC 7396.
## Access Control
Requester must have the `acct:account:u` permission for the space containing this account.

parameters.name: accountKrn
parameters.description: The KRN of the account to update

get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of accounts within the specified space with optional filtering.
## Access Control
Requester must have the `acct:account:r` permission for the space containing the accounts.

parameters.name: spaceKrn
parameters.description: The KRN of the space in which to look for the account(s)

parameters.name: typeKrn
parameters.description: The KRN of the type of account to look for

parameters.name: externalId
parameters.description: Filter accounts by external identifier

parameters.name: accountNumber
parameters.description: The account number to look for

parameters.name: excludeBalance
parameters.description: Set to true to exclude balance information from the response; default = false

parameters.name: [lookupFieldName]
parameters.description: Lookup fields to filter accounts by. The fields specified must match a defined `lookup` for the account type. The name of the field is the key, and the value is the value to match. The parameter name `[lookupFieldName]` shown here is a placeholder — substitute it with an actual lookup field name defined on the payable type, and repeat the parameter once per field in the lookup combination.

parameters.name: KUBRA-clientId
parameters.description: KUBRA-clientId or KUBRA-tenantId has to be provided

post.description:
Creates a new account within the specified space and realm.
## Access Control
Requester must have the `acct:account:c` and `acct:account:u` permissions for the space containing the account, and access to the target realm.

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: The realm in which to create the account

parameters.name: KUBRA-clientId
parameters.description: Client identifier for authorization

extensionFields.description: Client-defined extension field values for this account

post.description:
Looks up account KRNs for multiple account identifiers. Each request
item identifies a space, payable type, and external identifier. The
response returns one item for each request item, with either `acctKrn`
populated or item-level errors explaining why the account could not be
resolved.

This endpoint does not paginate results.

## Access Control

The requester must have the `acct:account:r` permission for each matched
account. If any matched account is not authorized, the endpoint returns
`403`.

get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of accounts within a specified realm for a
given client. The response includes account details and pagination
metadata. Use `q` for intelligent account search; when provided, it must
be at least 3 characters.

## Access Control
Any of the following allow access:
- an `authorized` relationship between the requester and an account exists
- requester has the `acct:account:r` permission for the client that owns
  the account

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: The realm containing the accounts.

parameters.name: clientKrn
parameters.description: The KRN of the client whose realm is being searched.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Intelligent account search query.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to return. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Page size to return. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: typeKrn
parameters.description: Filter accounts by payable type KRN.

parameters.name: accountNumber
parameters.description: Filter accounts by account number.

parameters.name: excludeBalance
parameters.description: Set to true to exclude balance information from the response; default = false.

get.description:
Returns the set of accounts that match the provided semi-private information about the accounts. If the lookup fields' values provided don't match any account with the specified accountNumber, the result set will be empty. This endpoint is intended to be used by consumers to verify their access to their accounts.
## Access Control
The space identified by `spaceKrn` must be visible to the requester. No additional permissions or relationships are required.

parameters.name: spaceKrn
parameters.description: The KRN of the space in which to look for the account(s)

parameters.name: typeKrn
parameters.description: The KRN of the type of account to look for.

parameters.name: accountNumber
parameters.description: The account number to look for.

parameters.name: excludeBalance
parameters.description: Set to false to include balance information from the response; default = true

parameters.name: [lookupFieldName]
parameters.description: Lookup fields to validate on accounts with the specified accountNumber. The fields specified must match a defined `lookup` for the account type. The name of the field is the key, and the value is the value to match. The parameter name `[lookupFieldName]` shown here is a placeholder — substitute it with an actual lookup field name defined on the payable type, and repeat the parameter once per field in the lookup combination.

get.description:
Retrieves the consumer settings for the specified account.
## Access Control
Requester must have the `acct:account:r` permission for the account.

parameters.name: accountKrn
parameters.description: The KRN of the account to retrieve consumer settings from

put.description:
Creates or updates the consumer settings for the specified account.
## Access Control
Requester must have the `acct:account:u` permission for the account.

parameters.name: accountKrn
parameters.description: The KRN of the account for which the consumer settings are being set

200.description: Consumer settings successfully created or updated

get.description:
Retrieves the configuration for the specified space. If no configuration exists, a default configuration is returned with `isStitchEnabled` set to false.
## Access Control
Requester must have the `acct:spc-config:r` permission for the client that owns the space.

parameters.name: spaceKrn
parameters.description: The KRN of the space for which the configuration is being retrieved

parameters.name: KUBRA-clientId
parameters.description: KUBRA-clientId or KUBRA-tenantId has to be provided

put.description:
Creates or updates the configuration for the specified space.
## Access Control
Requester must have the `acct:spc-config:u` permission for the client that owns the space.

parameters.name: spaceKrn
parameters.description: The KRN of the space for which the configuration is being set

parameters.name: KUBRA-clientId
parameters.description: KUBRA-clientId or KUBRA-tenantId has to be provided

200.description: Space configuration successfully created or updated
